form_fields.label: Description
form_fields.name: description_default_intelligent_acceptance
form_fields.default_value: Default: Includes ISO8583 and 3DS optimisations, 3DS upgrade, Network Tokens on the first attempt and fallback where necessary, AFT retries, and exemptions where no liability is impacted, and preferred scheme routing where processors are configured.

form_fields.label: Description
form_fields.name: description_custom_3ds_upgrade
form_fields.default_value:
Custom: Strategy that can be tailored to merchant needs and preferences; it already allows all ISO8583 optimizations, 3DS optimizations, Network Tokens on the first attempt and fallback where necessary, AFT retries, exemptions, and preferred scheme routing where processors are configured. Functionalities can be controlled via the usage of add-ons.
3DS upgrade: Allows 3DS upgrades.

form_fields.label: Description
form_fields.name: description_custom_no_3ds_upgrade
form_fields.default_value:
Custom: Strategy that can be tailored to merchant needs and preferences; it already allows all ISO8583 optimizations, 3DS optimizations, Network Tokens on the first attempt and fallback where necessary, AFT retries, exemptions, and preferred scheme routing where processors are configured. Functionalities can be controlled via the usage of add-ons.
No 3DS upgrades: Does not allow 3DS if not requested explicitly by the merchant

form_fields.label: Description
form_fields.name: description_shadow_enablement
form_fields.default_value: Free plan (Shadow): Enabling a free limited version of Intelligent Acceptance with restricted optimisations. This strategy is different from a free trial which is a limited-time offering of the full Intelligent Acceptance product.

form_fields.label: Description
form_fields.name: addons_description_custom_3ds_upgrade
form_fields.default_value:
• Disable API 3DS: Only honours 3DS decision from Fraud Detection and ignores 3DS requested via API
• Smart MCC Routing: Enables smart routing for merchants, leveraging best ranked MCC on first attempt, and second best ranked on subsequent attempts
• Disable CVV optimizations (card verification only): Disable optimizations removing CVV values on card verification requests only
• Disable CVV optimizations: Disable optimizations removing CVV values
• Disables AFT downgrades: Disables AFT downgrades and AFT purchase retries
• Disable double authentication retries: Disables double authentication retries
• Honour 3RI: Honours 3RI requests from the merchant
• Disable authentication downgrades: Disables authentication downgrades
• Disable 3DS upgrades on retries for US based issuers: Disables 3DS upgrades on retries for US based issuers
• Enable NSF MIT retries: Enable insufficient fund retries on MITs
• Disable NSF CIT retries: Disable insufficient fund retries on CITs
• Disable Google SPA Authentication: Disables authentication attempts with Google SPA.
• Honour AFT requests on the initial attempt: Honours AFT requests on the initial attempt if requested by merchant
• Restrict double EMVCo challenge: Disables double EMVCo challenge requests if a successful challenge was completed. Restriction does not apply if the scheme is changed between attempts
• Restrict Visa Cat1 retries for MIT transactions: Disables retrying on Visa Category 1 decline codes for MIT transactions
• Restrict retries on recommendation code 03/21 for MIT Mastercard: Restrict all retries if the previous attempt's recommendation code was 03 or 21 for MIT Mastercard transactions only
• Restrict retries on recommendation code 03/21 for CIT Mastercard: Restrict all retries if the previous attempt's recommendation code was 03 or 21 for CIT Mastercard transactions only
• Restrict Visa Cat1 retries for CIT transactions: Disables retrying on Visa Category 1 decline codes for CIT transactions
• Disable 3DS upgrades on card verifs:  Disables 3DS redirection for card verification payments
• Restrict 3DS upgrades on first attempt:  Restricts 3DS redirection for first attempts for Visa/Mastercard CITs where possible. Excludes cards issued in France.
• Restrict 3DS upgrades on first attempt for US issuers:  Restricts 3DS redirection for first attempts for Visa/Mastercard CITs for US issuers where possible.
